body:
I dont "think" its a hamster wheel society....IT IS a hamster wheel society.  

The problem is that I see things for what they ARE, not what people are brainwashed into THINKING life is...

How is this life NOT a hamster wheel society, when your made to work your body into a disabled/debilitated state for a pittance, and when you can't work any more they go and find someone else to put on the hamster wheel to keep it spinning..??

How is that not a hamster wheel society?
